title: Verify native storage build prerequisites
deliverable: Bundled rusqlite compile/link and temporary database smoke check

acceptance: Essential input/navigation works or a documented GUI reconsideration blocks the gate.

title: Review the native foundation gate
deliverable: Prototype evidence and updated GUI/toolchain ADR
acceptance: Framework decision is supported by real behavior; no hidden prerequisite or essential text failure remains.

title: Implement design tokens and reusable controls
deliverable: Light/dark semantic tokens, labeled control variants, focus/error/disabled states and component showcase
acceptance: Both native themes use shared tokens; actual contrast and focus visibility checked; no feature completion implied.
evidence: app/docs/ui/UI-01-TOKENS-AND-COMPONENTS.md: shared light/dark tokens (ui/theme.rs) and reusable controls (ui/components.rs) including error fields and messages; every text, accent, control-border, focus, error and disabled-state pair measured (failing planned border replaced); component showcase design fixture (ui/showcase.rs) in both themes; live Light/Dark/System switching; 15 tests in tests/theme.rs and tests/showcase.rs; showcase and focus/error screenshots.

title: Specify and prove typography and font assets
deliverable: Reviewed font files/licenses, sizes, fallback order and multilingual typography fixtures
acceptance: Exact asset versions/notices recorded; font proof feeds R0-04; glyph presence alone is not bidi success.

title: Build the responsive workspace composition
deliverable: Header, project sidebar, diagram tabs, tool row, canvas, inspector and status bar with retained panel preferences
acceptance: 1280x800 and 800x500 layouts have no unreachable controls; drawers restore focus and do not overlap work surfaces unintentionally.
evidence: app/docs/ui/UI-03-RESPONSIVE-WORKSPACE.md: header (48) with catalog menu, tab row (38), tool row (40), canvas, project panel 240 and inspector 300 that dock at 1020+ and become drawers over the canvas below that; Escape/Close/toggle close drawers and return focus; hidden panels retained across sizes; 15 tests in tests/workspace.rs plus no-overlap checks at 800x500, 1280x800 and 1440x900; Escape-on-focused-button and borderless-toggle defects fixed. Restart persistence of panel preferences waits for the preferences store.

title: Design welcome and project entry screens
deliverable: New/Open/recent/recovery presentation states and missing-path/invalid-name cases
acceptance: Native fixture scenarios are explicitly labeled; unavailable Open/Save never pretends to access real files.
evidence: app/docs/ui/UI-04-WELCOME-AND-ENTRY.md: app starts on a welcome screen (ui/welcome.rs) with New project, disabled Open project and recent entries (storage reason), labeled sample recent list and recovery notice, recent search with no-match state, missing-path error with removal; new-project form validated by diagram_core::ProjectName with the error beside the field, only Class diagram creatable, Create/Enter opens an empty diagram, Cancel/Escape returns focus; 17 tests in tests/welcome.rs; first-frame style crash, focus loss on the error state and an unlabeled recovery fixture found and fixed.

title: Build navigator and diagram-tab presentation
deliverable: Diagrams/Model navigation, search, empty/no-match states, tab overflow and keyboard selection
acceptance: Selection/reveal behavior and model-versus-view wording reviewed using fixtures; real session binding remains UI-13.
evidence: app/docs/ui/UI-05-NAVIGATOR-AND-TABS.md: project panel with search, Diagrams (views) and Model (shared) sections, 'shown in' wording, reveal of classes on other diagrams, distinct empty and no-match states; diagram tabs with Tab role, named Close, per-tab selection, More tabs overflow keeping the active tab visible; 15 tests in tests/navigator.rs plus usability-audit scenes; real-window screenshots.

title: Unify command catalog and tool availability
deliverable: Typed UI intents and one catalog for menus, tools, shortcuts, palette and disabled reasons
acceptance: All visible actions have prerequisites, effect owner and test contract; focused text input keeps editing shortcuts.
evidence: app/docs/ui/UI-06-COMMAND-CATALOG.md: one catalog (ui/commands.rs) drives the header, tool row, tab row, menu, Ctrl+K search and shortcuts, every disabled command states why, text fields keep editing keys; typed UiIntent queue (ui/intents.rs) applied by one coordinator; per-command ActionContract (prerequisite, effect, owner, undo policy, covering test) checked against the test sources; 22 tests in tests/commands.rs.

title: Present every canvas interaction state
deliverable: Empty/single/multiple/relation selections, inline edit, move/resize/connect/cancel/read-only fixtures
acceptance: Native fixtures distinguish transient preview from committed content; model mutations and actual gesture engine remain M2.

title: Build contextual inspector presentation
deliverable: Model versus Appearance, members, relation endpoints/multiplicity, mixed values, invalid drafts and advanced sections
acceptance: Fields have labels and explicit commit/cancel rules; mixed-value edits are deliberate; no widget writes authoritative document records directly.
evidence: app/docs/ui/UI-08-CONTEXTUAL-INSPECTOR.md: inspector fields edit drafts committed by Enter or focus change through validated intents, Escape cancels, invalid drafts keep their error; no-selection, single-class (Model section, members, collapsed Appearance/Advanced), mixed multi-selection (explicit mixed values, no silent edits) and relationship (endpoint roles and validated multiplicities) contexts; 14 tests in tests/inspector.rs plus usability-audit scenes; direct-write, missing-glyph, label-collision and audit-clipping defects fixed.

title: Design dialogs, validation and asynchronous status
deliverable: Save/open/loading/error/recovery/export/dirty-close states, validation drawer and focus return
acceptance: Every failure/cancel path has a defined result; simulated states remain review-only; stale save acknowledgments and retry semantics documented.

title: Verify designed keyboard and accessible layouts
deliverable: Native traversal/focus, named controls, object-list alternatives, drawer behavior and scale checks for designed surfaces
acceptance: R0-04 supplies completed framework evidence; designed screens add no keyboard traps or hidden essential actions; supported sizes/scales recorded.

title: Define notation capability and surface contract
deliverable: Class tool/inspector capability definition and future Flowchart/Use Case/ER/Sequence surface mapping
acceptance: Only delivered notations are creatable; future sequence interaction requirements remain explicit; no runtime plugin framework introduced.
evidence: app/docs/ui/UI-11-NOTATION-CONTRACT.md: compile-time NOTATIONS table (ui/notation.rs, no plugin framework) gives tools, inspector sections, relationships and interaction model per notation; tool row, inspector and new-project form read it; only Class is creatable; Flowchart/Use Case (M4), ER/Sequence (M5) surface mappings with explicit sequence temporal requirements; 8 tests in tests/notation.rs.

title: Pass the complete native UI design review
deliverable: Both-theme screenshots, component/state inventory, keyboard map and reviewed command integration contracts
acceptance: All required UI surfaces reviewed in native app; fixture-only behavior clearly disclosed; functional work starts with stable presentation boundaries.

title: Define typed IDs and document records
deliverable: Classes/members/relations, diagrams/views, finite geometry and explicit ordering
acceptance: Model IDs and view IDs cannot be interchanged; checked construction rejects invalid geometry.
evidence: app/docs/functionality/AGENT-B-EVIDENCE.md: typed ElementId/MemberId/RelationId/DiagramId/ViewId (compile_fail doc tests prove they cannot be interchanged); model records separate from views; checked finite geometry; explicit member and diagram order; diagram-core/tests/model.rs. 2026-11-05

title: Implement domain and relation validation
deliverable: Reference, ownership, association and generalization checks
acceptance: Invalid references, self-generalization and cycles produce typed errors without edits.
evidence: app/docs/functionality/AGENT-B-EVIDENCE.md: typed DomainError; self-generalization, duplicate and cycle rejection without edits; multiplicity grammar; whole-document check with error/warning severity; diagram-core/tests/model.rs. 2026-11-05

title: Apply reversible command transactions
deliverable: Command enum, validated ChangeSet and inverse patches
acceptance: Compound creation/removal is atomic; a failed command preserves the previous document.
evidence: app/docs/functionality/AGENT-B-EVIDENCE.md: Command enum with labels -> validated ChangeSet of record patches; all-or-nothing apply with rollback; exact inverses; compound create and delete-everywhere atomic with impact counts; diagram-core/tests/commands.rs. 2026-11-05

title: Add history and saved-state identities
deliverable: Undo/redo, SessionId, Revision, StateId and bounded history
acceptance: Undo returns to the correct semantic state; saved-state tracking survives undo/redo and branching.
evidence: app/docs/functionality/AGENT-B-EVIDENCE.md: Session with undo/redo, SessionId, Revision, StateId; saved state survives undo/redo/branching; other-session and older-state save results cannot clear newer edits; history bounded to 500 whole transactions (byte budget not measured yet); diagram-core/tests/commands.rs. 2026-11-05

acceptance: Old session/revision results cannot clear new edits; pending work is bounded and orderly.
